dresses: full grain sack lying on its side, 0.97 x 0.69 x 0.26 m: jute sackcloth (hessian scan), simulated bulge with pinched corner ears, rolled and whip-stitched mouth at +X with a loose tail of twine, sewn side seams (baked)

build: DINK_PP=<PhotorealPass> blender -b -t 4 --python Props/tools/props_bake.py -- <asset>; then blender -b Props/_build/Props.blend --python Props/tools/props_merge.py
status: round 2: unique bake, reviewed; not claimed photoreal where known_weaknesses lists faults
material_exception: unique bake (T_<Asset>_BC/_N/_ORM and _E where listed), private to this prop, not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2: the coordinator asked for sculpted or displaced high-detail sources baked to the game mesh with AO and curvature edge wear, true metal in ORM.B and emissive masks, which the shared tiling library cannot carry. Non-overlapping UV0; no vertex colour.
known_weaknesses: Round 2 unique bake from a cloth simulation (sewn pouch inflated by pressure and dropped on the floor), four review rounds (r6). Last look still faults: the cloth is clean (few stains, no patch or stencil), folds are the soft dimples of an inflated cushion rather than the sag of loose grain, the rolled hem, twine stitches and side seams are baked into the normal map only, so the mouth has no silhouette detail. Colour variants of round 1 (olive, madder) are now a BC tint for the integrator.
